title: eth/fetcher: throttle peers which deliver many invalid transactions
audit_reason: The source adds throttling for peers delivering many invalid transactions. It establishes attacker-controlled traffic and a multi-input anti-DoS measure, but not a crash or single-input node takedown.
label: transactions

title: Tree states to support per-slot state diffs
audit_reason: The source fixes a panic when a hierarchical state diff is absent at a requested slot during a broad storage redesign. It does not connect the panic to a malicious attestation or other attacker-controlled input.
label: light-client

title: Add cache for parallel HTTP requests
audit_reason: The source describes many parallel HTTP state requests and adds request deduplication. This is externally supplied load requiring multiple requests, not a single malicious attestation or demonstrated crash.
label: beacon-chain:attestation

title: fix panic on bad tx sender
audit_reason: The source explicitly states that handcrafted RLP transaction bytes trigger a panic. GitHub metadata dates the merge to 2014-12-18, before Ethereum mainnet, so it cannot establish live-network >33% impact at the fix date.
label: transactions

title: RPC Corrections and deadlock fix
audit_reason: The source states that RPC handling had a deadlock, but does not identify the trigger as one attacker message. GitHub metadata dates the merge to 2019-11-29, before Beacon Chain mainnet.
label: p2p-interface

title: Re-process early sampling requests
audit_reason: This is an explicitly basic, non-tested PeerDAS early-request feature whose next steps include better DoS protection. It is not a vulnerability fix or evidence of a realized availability failure.
label: data-availability-sampling

title: core/state: fix trie prefetcher for verkle
audit_reason: The source reports a Verkle prefetcher panic only once Verkle is activated. It does not identify a crafted transaction or a deployed remote trigger.
label: state-trie
